title: Ordered affine-space integration and the binary relative product
statement:
In the finite-coefficient conventions [def-pur-conventions], put $A=A_{E,n}$ and let $Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme. Write $p_m:X_m=\mathbf A^m_Y\to Y$, $m\geq1$, and $q_m:X_{m+1}\to X_m$ for the last-coordinate affine-line projection [def-sbc-affine-space], so $p_{m+1}=p_mq_m$. Put $T_m=A_{X_m}(m)[2m]$ using [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], $V_m=Rp_{m!}T_m$, $a=p_1$, $T=T_1$, and $U=Ra_!T$. Let $t_Y:U\to A_Y$ be exactly the normalized integration in [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison]. Let $\gamma_{p_m,A_Y}$ be the ordered comparison [def-pur-affine-space-comparison], and define its actual exceptional transpose by
$$I_m=\varepsilon_{p_m,A_Y}\circ Rp_{m!}(\gamma_{p_m,A_Y}):V_m\longrightarrow A_Y,$$
using the constructible exceptional adjunction [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] and the tensor-unit identification of the source. Assume that the $V_m$ are bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude, and that these affine-line integrations commute with base change: for every $v:Y'\to Y$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $v^*t_Y=t_{Y'}\circ\operatorname{Ex}_!$ under the canonical Tate pullback identifications; make the same assumption over each such base $Y'$. Let
$$\kappa_{m,1}:V_{m+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}V_m\otimes_A^LU$$
be the specified relative compact-support product construction of [thm-sf-kunneth-relative] for $(p_m,T_m)$ and $(a,T)$, with $T_m\boxtimes T=T_{m+1}$ under canonical twist, shift and pullback identifications. Then the actual maps satisfy
$$I_1=t_Y,\qquad I_{m+1}=(I_m\otimes t_Y)\circ\kappa_{m,1}\quad(m\geq1),$$
where $A_Y\otimes_A^LA_Y\cong A_Y$ is understood. The assertion uses the canonical finite-coefficient exchanges, projection transformations and compact-support composition comparisons; it makes no coordinate-permutation assertion.
